cases.name: original
argv:
set -euo pipefail
checkpoint="$1"
receipt="$2"
shift 2
expected=$(python -c 'import json,sys; from pathlib import Path; from tools.quantized_optimizers.score_dense import read_checkpoint_file; r=read_checkpoint_file(Path(sys.argv[1])/"model.pt"); Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(r)); print(r["sha256"])' "$checkpoint" "$receipt")
exec torchrun --standalone --nproc-per-node=1 -m tools.quantized_optimizers.score_dense --checkpoint "$checkpoint" --checkpoint-sha256 "$expected" "$@"
